**q22.** Dispatcher: `APIV1Service.DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:15`, called from `CreateMemo` at `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:157`; it fans out per user webhook via `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` (`memo_service_webhooks.go:48`) with activity type `memos.memo.created`. Delivery package: `internal/webhook` (`PostAsync` queues onto a bounded channel drained by 4 goroutines, `internal/webhook/webhook.go:38-53,182`; HTTP POST in `Post`, `webhook.go:117`, SSRF-guarded client). Signing: HMAC-SHA256 in Standard Webhooks form — `whsec_`-prefixed base64 secret, signature over `msgID.timestamp.body`, headers `webhook-id`, `webhook-timestamp`, `webhook-signature: v1,<base64>` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:129-149`).

**q25.** Engine: CEL (google/cel-go) — the memo filter engine in `internal/filter/` (`engine.go:24` `NewEngine`, `DefaultEngine`; `schema.go` field/env declarations, `parser.go` CEL AST → IR, `ir.go`, `render.go`). Mechanism: the handler passes filter strings into `store.FindMemo.Filters` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` ListMemos → `memo_service_query.go`); each dialect driver calls `filter.DefaultEngine()` and `filter.AppendConditions(ctx, engine, find.Filters, filter.Dialect{SQLite|Postgres|MySQL}, &where, &args)` (`internal/filter/helpers.go:9`; e.g. `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:57-61`), which compiles CEL → dialect-agnostic condition IR → a dialect-specific SQL fragment + placeholder args in `internal/filter/render.go` (JSON access, `LIKE`/`ILIKE`, `?` vs `$n` handled per dialect).

**q26.** `memo` (the memo row itself, plus comment memo rows deleted by the handler), `memo_relation` (both `memo_id` and `related_memo_id` directions), `attachment` (explicit cascade in `Store.DeleteMemo`, `store/memo.go:140-166`; also removes stored files), and `memo_share` — only via the DB-level `ON DELETE CASCADE` FK (`store/migration/*/LATEST.sql:108-109`), which is inactive on SQLite because foreign keys are disabled in the DSN (`store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:53`). `reaction` rows are read for the webhook payload but never deleted (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:544`).

**q27.** Mechanism: the built React bundle is embedded into the Go binary with `//go:embed dist/*` and served by Echo's static-file middleware plus an SPA index.html fallback. Files: `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:21-22` (embed), `:41-61` (`Serve`, static middleware + `spaFallbackMiddleware`); wired in `server/server.go:68` (`frontend.NewFrontendService(profile, store).Serve(ctx, echoServer)`).

**q28.**
- `s3presign.Runner` — started in `Server.startBackgroundRunners` (`server/server.go:148-166`): `RunOnce` at startup, then a `time.Ticker` loop every 12h (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:26-39`).
- webhook async dispatch workers — 4 goroutines started by package `init()` draining a 128-slot channel, queue-driven (not time-scheduled) (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:41-53`).
- SSE hub goroutines/heartbeat per connection — `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go`, `sse_handler.go:17` (30s heartbeat).

Unused infrastructure: `internal/scheduler` (a full cron scheduler, `internal/scheduler/scheduler.go`, `doc.go`) is referenced only by its own tests — nothing in the server uses it. Also `server/runner/memopayload.Runner` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:19,27`) is never instantiated; only its `RebuildMemoPayload` helper is called inline from `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108,447`.

**q29.** Interceptor: `authInterceptor` in `web/src/connect.ts:152-181` (installed on the Connect transport at `:184`). Tokens: short-lived JWT access token sent as `Authorization: Bearer` (stored/refreshed in `web/src/auth-state.ts`, proactive expiry refresh + reactive 401 retry via `AuthService.RefreshToken`), and an HttpOnly refresh-token cookie sent with `credentials: "include"` (`web/src/connect.ts:56-62`; cookie built server-side in `server/router/api/v1/auth_service_session.go:224`). The backend also accepts Personal Access Tokens on the same header. Validation: package `server/auth` (`authenticator.go` — `AuthenticateByAccessTokenV2`, `AuthenticateByRefreshToken`, `AuthenticateByPAT`; `token.go`), invoked from `server/router/api/v1/authz.go` / `connect_interceptors.go` (`NewAuthInterceptor`) and the gateway middleware in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:69-92`.

**q30.**
- memo created: `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:15` (called `memo_service.go:157`), activity `memos.memo.created`
- memo updated: `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` — `memo_service_webhooks.go:20` (called `memo_update_helpers.go:67`), activity `memos.memo.updated`
- memo deleted: `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` — `memo_service_webhooks.go:25` (called `memo_service.go:562`), activity `memos.memo.deleted`
- comment created: `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` — `memo_service_webhooks.go:30` (called `memo_service_comments.go:119`), activity `memos.memo.comment.created`

All converge on `webhook.PostAsync` → `webhook.Post` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go:182` / `:117` (the first three go through the shared helper `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook`, `memo_service_webhooks.go:48`).
